summary:
Project Summary – Data Analysis, EDA & Data Visualization

I have completed a comprehensive Data Analysis project using Python. The project includes data cleaning, data preprocessing, Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA), statistical analysis, and data visualization.

I used Python libraries such as Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, and Seaborn to analyze the dataset, identify patterns, handle missing values, detect inconsistencies, and generate meaningful visualizations.

The main objective of this project was to transform raw data into meaningful insights and present the findings through clear and informative visualizations.

Tools & Technologies: Python, Jupyter Notebook, Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, Seaborn.

Project Status: Completed and ready for submission.
details:
Project Information

Project Title: Data Analysis, Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) & Data Visualization

Project Description:
This project focuses on analyzing a raw CSV dataset using Python to extract meaningful insights and discover hidden patterns. It involves data cleaning, handling missing and duplicate values, correcting inconsistencies, performing statistical analysis, and creating informative visualizations.

Objectives:

- Understand and explore the dataset.
- Clean and preprocess raw data.
- Identify trends, patterns, and relationships.
- Perform Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA).
- Create meaningful charts and visualizations.
- Generate insights to support data-driven decisions.

Tools & Technologies:

- Python
- Jupyter Notebook
- Pandas
- NumPy
- Matplotlib
- Seaborn

Expected Outcome:

A clean, structured, and analyzed dataset with meaningful insights, statistical findings, and professional visualizations that make complex data easier to understand.

Project Category: Data Science & Data Analytics

Project Status: Completed
